verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox chains all 3 Q stacks into a knockup before level 6; you win every trade you take on a marked vital with Riposte held in reserve.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a resource-timing duel, not a stat check: Aatrox's all-in depends on landing a clean 3-stack Darkin Blade chain for the edge knockup, and Fiora's answer is holding Riposte to eat that exact hit while her passive vitals dictate where she should even be trading. The 51.8% Fiora win rate over 519 games and EVEN lane/solo-kill grading both say neither side is structurally ahead — the game is won by whoever plays their cooldown windows better.

theirWindow.when: Aatrox lands all 3 Q stacks in a row
theirWindow.what: The third Darkin Blade hit knocks up on the outer edge and chains into empowered Deathbringer's Stance autos plus W (Infernal Chains) pull for a full combo. If you see him land Q1 clean and immediately reposition for Q2, disengage or pre-commit Riposte to eat the knockup rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: vital marked and Riposte (W) is up
yourWindow.what: Lunge (Q) onto the marked vital for the bonus true damage and the E/W cooldown refund, then immediately fire E (Bladework) for two empowered autos before he can reset with Umbral Dash. This is your highest damage-per-second window in the entire lane.

start.why: The dominant start at 51.6% over 607 games (93.1% pick) — the extra sustain and AD let you take the level 1-2 trades before his E unlocks without needing to disengage.

boots.why: Best-performing boots here at 54.2% over 439 games (79.2% pick); Aatrox's damage is almost entirely auto-attacks and Darkin Blade physical hits, so flat reduction blunts every stacked Q chain.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate path (61.6% over 146 games); the active lets you cleave through his summoned Sunder minions and confirm a vital reset mid-trade.
Second in the same 44.2%-pick path; the movement speed and empowered-auto burst let you land E's payload before he can Umbral Dash away.
Closes the 61.6% WR path; damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his Deathbringer's Stance-empowered counter-hit after your all-in.

situational.when: you are ahead early and want a faster burst spike instead of the full Hydra path
he is shoving you off wave with Q poke and you need the sustain/wave-clear tool
his R (World Ender) sustain or Deathbringer's Stance healing is winning extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: The 59.6% WR page outperforms the Conqueror page (52%) here because PTA's burst amp rewards your fast Q-vital into E-empowered-auto combo, ending the trade before he can proc Deathbringer's Stance back — sustained fights are where his healing catches up, so you want to win fast, not long.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 93.6% of games at 52.1% WR; Ignite is the key tech here since it directly cuts the healing from his R (World Ender) and Deathbringer's Stance during your level 6+ all-in, denying the exact sustain that lets him win extended trades.

playing.title: Track your passive vitals constantly
playing.detail: Fiora's passive marks four vitals on Aatrox; only commit your Q dash to a marked vital, since hitting it grants bonus true damage and refunds W/E cooldowns for the follow-up.

playing.title: Hold Riposte for his Q3 or W
playing.detail: Don't burn W (Riposte) early to poke — save it to parry the edge-hit knockup on his third Darkin Blade stack or the Infernal Chains pull, both of which start his real combo.

playing.title: Respect level 3-5 all-in windows
playing.detail: Once he has E (Umbral Dash), he can chain Q stacks and dash to close distance if you kite; play from max Q-Lunge range and don't extend past your minion wave in this window.

playing.title: Punish his used E and Q charges
playing.detail: After he burns Umbral Dash to engage or his three Q charges are on cooldown, he loses both his gap-close and his knockup — this is your safest window to Lunge in for a vital-marked trade.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown-down R at level 6
playing.detail: Fiora's R (Grand Challenge) reveals all vitals and deals true damage plus a heal; time your all-in for when his R (World Ender) is down so his sustain can't offset the true damage.

playing.title: Kite with E's movement speed, don't stand and auto
playing.detail: E (Bladework) grants bonus movement speed on cast — use it to walk-and-auto around his slower melee range rather than trading auto-for-auto, which favors his Deathbringer's Stance procs.

playing.title: Use Ignite to close out all-ins, not to open them
playing.detail: Save Ignite for the moment he tries to sustain back through Deathbringer's Stance or R healing during your level 6+ engage, rather than flaring it at the start of the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, pick rates, and every item/rune/summoner listed here are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (Fiora 49.4% overall over 16,247 games; 51.8% vs Aatrox over 519 games); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns explaining those numbers are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Keep in mind that Aatrox will use (E) to dodge [W]. Always keep Aatrox’s range in mind.
